name: Hatred
overview: Scripture reveals that hatred is a serious condition of the heart, forbidden among brethren as seen in Leviticus 19:17, which commands believers not to harbor hatred but to lovingly rebuke sin. God Himself hates workers of iniquity and wickedness, demonstrating a righteous hatred rooted in His holiness (Psalms 5:5; 45:7). Believers are called to hate evil because of their love for the Lord, who protects His saints from the wicked (Psalms 97:10). Yet, the experience of hatred is also a reality for the godly, as enemies may hate without cause, causing bitterness and trial (Psalms 25:19; 35:19).
